nodes.name: DB: Verificar se Telefone Já Existe

parameters.query: SELECT id, belle_id, clint_id FROM clientes WHERE telefone = '{{ $json.telefone }}' OR celular = '{{ $json.telefone }}' LIMIT 1;

parameters.body:
={
  "nome": "{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.nome }}",
  "celular": "{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.telefone }}",
  "email": "{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.email }}",
  "cpf": "{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.cpf }}",
  "tpOrigem": "{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.origem }}",
  "codEstab": 1
}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO leads (clint_id, belle_id, nome, telefone, email, cpf, origem, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.clint_id }}',
  {{ $json.codigo || 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.nome.replace(/'/g,"''") }}',
  '{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.telefone }}',
  '{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.email }}',
  '{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.cpf }}',
  '{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.origem }}',
  '{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.utm_source }}',
  '{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.utm_medium }}',
  '{{ $('Extrair Campos do Lead').item.json.utm_campaign }}',
  'novo'
)
ON CONFLICT (clint_id) DO UPDATE SET
  belle_id = EXCLUDED.belle_id,
  atualizado_em = NOW()
RETURNING id, belle_id;
